# Pure Herbex - Koveria Glow Botanical Skincare

> Pure Herbex is a premium Pakistani botanical skincare brand formulating 100% artisanal, freshly handmade herbal products for daily natural skin radiance, sun protection, and acne defense.

## Core Products & Collections

- [Koveria Glow Complete 3-Piece Kit](https://pureherbex.com/product/koveria-glow-complete-kit): Artisanal Rose Face Pack, Aloe Hydration Toner, and Steam-Distilled Rose Water + Free Canvas Beach Tote.
- [Koveria Glow Face Pack Powder](https://pureherbex.com/product/koveria-glow-face-pack): Damask rose petals, organic moringa, multani mitti, and turmeric powder for instant skin brightening.
- [Koveria Glow Hydrating Toner Mist](https://pureherbex.com/product/koveria-glow-toner): Organic aloe vera, cucumber extract, and niacinamide for 24h skin hydration.
- [Pure Steam-Distilled Rose Water](https://pureherbex.com/product/pure-rose-water): Pure Rosa Damascena hydrosol for pore tightening and skin soothing.
